# v2026.10.44

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.44.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.44.md).

This release covers **19 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Filters work like ClickUp's, with groups, And / Or and date ranges, on Jobs, Invoices and Reconcile. ([#233](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/233))
- List columns resize and move by drag, saved per person, on Jobs, Invoices and Reconcile. ([#238](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/238))
- Saved views with a default for each person, as ClickUp's view tabs. ([#239](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/239))
- Every page uses the whole width; lists and the board sit in one window with the tools in one place. ([#237](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/237))
- Save on a Pending invoice runs every check and moves it to Ready. ([#250](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/250))
- A job's problems are toggle chips that open the Fix sidecar, so the panel keeps one layout. ([#232](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/232))
- Rules is laid out like Claude's Customize page. ([#236](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/236))
- A client's reference number in the Reference, such as a patient number, is no longer flagged as a stray number. ([#244](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/244))

## Changes

- A publish guard lets an agent republish an installation after a release. ([#231](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/231))
- The Flow Design System artifact is built from the code, with a live card per shared component. ([#225](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/225))
- Filters work like ClickUp's, with groups, And / Or and date ranges, on Jobs, Invoices and Reconcile. ([#233](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/233))
- A job's problems are toggle chips that open the Fix sidecar, so the panel keeps one layout. ([#232](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/232))
- Rules is laid out like Claude's Customize page. ([#236](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/236))
- List columns resize and move by drag, saved per person, on Jobs, Invoices and Reconcile. ([#238](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/238))
- Every page uses the whole width; lists and the board sit in one window with the tools in one place. ([#237](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/237))
- Save on a Pending invoice runs every check and moves it to Ready. ([#250](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/250))
- Saved views with a default for each person, as ClickUp's view tabs. ([#239](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/239))

## Fixes

- A filter's value list has no empty space at the left, as ClickUp's. ([#235](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/235))
- Invoice placeholders are generic, and the Item placeholder fits. ([#241](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/241))
- Rules cards keep their size on a wide page. ([#242](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/242))
- Name people by full name, else their whole email. ([#243](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/243))
- A client's reference number in the Reference is not a stray number. ([#244](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/244))
- Serve columns.js and person.js, so Jobs, Reconcile and every page load again. ([#245](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/245))
- Take a person's name from their sign-in when Flow has none. ([#246](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/246))
- A keydown with no key no longer throws a page error. ([#249](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/249))
